purpose: Direct answer to the user complaint: the creation suite still uses a Mixamo soldier and has no real WWE 2K / No Mercy / WrestleMania XIX templates. This pack defines the template SCHEMA; the code lane implements it. No famous names, no real wrestler likenesses.

templates.source: WWE 2K CAW structure (Genesis/CAK/Pofo): body proportions, head/face/hair, attire layers, pofo attributes, 18-category moveset, entrance (music/motion/titantron/pyro/lighting)
No Mercy CAW structure (banked wrestling.json + GameFAQs CAW guides)

templates.move_craft_guard: Fail-closed compatibility check on custom-move attribute combos (Fire Pro warns incompatible combos can freeze — WH must refuse invalid combos, not crash)

templates.source: Wrestling Empire 350 editable defaults + match creator

defaults_rule: The suite's default fighter MUST be one of these templates (owner picks which first), NEVER the Mixamo soldier. The Mixamo soldier is removed from the default slot; it may remain only as an explicitly-labelled legacy import, if at all.
status: SCHEMA ONLY — implementation belongs to the creation-suite/code lane; this lane does not edit suite code or existing moveset files.
